notes.title: EA 0.4 - SCP-323-1 and more!
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Playable SCP: SCP-323-1 (The Wendigo) joins the roster of playable characters.
[*] Dynamic Obstacles: Added randomized obstacles to maps to break long corridors and increase gameplay variety. These can become walls or vaulting points. 
[*] SCP-4166-2 Improvements: Now only one can be summoned at a time. Using the ability again will unsummon it. This change helps resolve frustration when SCP-4166-2 would teleport mid-chase. It will also spot humans more effectively.
[*] Randomized SCP Selection: The chosen SCP is now random when entering the lobby.
[*] Crosshair Per SCP: Your crosshair now changes depending on the SCP you’re playing.
[*] Map Icon: Added a map icon to the human HUD.
[*] Hitmarker Feedback: A blood hitmarker now appears on the human HUD when SCPs land hits.
[*] Tutorial While Waiting: Displays a role-specific tutorial while waiting for players to join the match.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] SCP-4166-1 is now moderately faster.
[*] SCP-106 is now slightly faster than humans.
[*] Increased attack range and hit collision radius for SCPs.
[*] The H key now properly hides and restores the HUD.
[*] Map Layout: Added vault points to the upper hall in the Theater map.
[/list]

[h1]Map & Environment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Restored map loading screens for all levels and added a new Chicago Theater loading screen.
[*] Removed an invisible wall near plants and fixed a hole in the Chicago Theater map.
[*] Fixed theater chairs being vaultable.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed loadout selection mismatch between lobby and game start.
[*] Fixed leaderboards showing empty results.
[*] Fixed an issue where SCP would start alone in a match while others remained in the lobby.
[/list]

[h3]Donations[/h3]
Added a Ko-fi link to the main menu: you can now support the game through donations.

notes.title: Update 0.3.8.8 (EA) - Bugfixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]SCP: Nemesi - EA 0.3.8.8 Changelog 🎅[/h1]

This update focuses on improving both gameplay and user experience, addressing longstanding issues and introducing quality-of-life improvements.

[h2]Lobbies[/h2]
Lobbies are still a work in progress, and we're actively addressing all the issues. To help players, we've added [b]three new options[/b]:  
- A [b]Refresh Lobby[/b] button.  
- A [b]Debug Menu[/b] for troubleshooting, which provides additional tools to manage and resolve lobby-related issues.
- A [b]Toggle[/b] to disable auto-join for lobbies. This is useful for hosting your own lobby without joining others automatically. 

[h2]New Features [/h2] 
- [b]Red Crosshair for SCPs:[/b] SCP crosshairs now turn red when a human is within melee range, providing better feedback during encounters. However, SCPs still need to wait for the attack cooldown, displayed on the bottom-right of the screen, before striking.  
- [b]Blood Effects:[/b] Added to the SCP HUD for improved visual feedback when successfully hitting a human.  
- [b]Proximity Alert for SCP-173:[/b] Human HUD now flashes yellow on the side SCP-173 is approaching from, providing a visual cue to help players identify its location. This feature reduces reliance on audio cues and enhances situational awareness.
- [b]SCP-049-2[/b] now has an [b]attack animation[/b].  

[h2]SCP 4166 Enhancements[/h2]
  - Added a quick [b]black fade[/b] and an on-screen message [b]when teleported by SCP 4166-2[/b].  
  - [b]SCP 4166-2 now disappears after hitting a human[/b], and its damage has been increased.  

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
  - Added a [b]"Currently Spectating..."[/b] text on the death screen widget along the name of the player you are spectating.  
  - [b]SCP 106 HUD[/b] now shows a [b]block icon[/b] if it cannot walk through a pointed mesh.  
  - [b]Stamina regeneration[/b] has been [b]increased[/b].  
  - Objective markers no longer disappear after respawn.  

[h2]Fixes[/h2]  
- [b]Theater Map Issues:[/b] Resolved various bugs in the theater map, including player and SCP movement problems.  
- [b]Speed Buffs/Debuffs:[/b] Fixed inconsistencies with speed buffs and debuffs, and added a slow-down effect for SCP 049 attacks, similar to SCP 4166.  
  - Corrected issues where players could get stuck in specific areas (e.g in the theater map, in front of the hole above the stairs).  
  - Addressed bugs with lobby loadout syncing and character selection inconsistencies.  

And as always, thank you for playing SCP: Nemesi! 🎄

notes.title: Update v0.3.8.7 - Lobbies, new Fog, Bugfixes and UI Improvements!
notes.content:
This update introduces proper [b]lobby support![/b] Upon selecting 'PLAY', users will automatically be placed into a random lobby alongside other players. If there are insufficient participants, AI bots will fill vacant spots, and you will still be able to play.

[b]Players will be assigned randomly[/b] to either the SCP or Human factions. They can then navigate through different tabs to select the SCP they will play (human characters are randomized), customize their loadout, and access additional features. Furthermore, players have the option to [b]invite friends[/b] directly through the Steam Overlay or join their existing lobbies.

In response to user feedback, we have implemented several visual improvements. Specifically, [b]the fog effect for Humans has been significantly reduced in density[/b], creating a lighter visual atmosphere. Additionally, a [b]new running effect[/b] has been introduced to enhance the perception of speed during gameplay.

notes.title: Update 0.3.8.1 - Noise markers, SCP-173 ability, Desync state, Maps and more!
notes.content:
Update 0.3.8.1 - 20240208 is now live! This comprehensive update introduces a combination of new content additions and bug fixes, enhancing the overall gameplay experience. The detailed breakdown of the changes is as follows:

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
- [b]Noise Markers[/b]: Human actions such as running, sliding, vaulting, picking up items, and performing tasks will now trigger noise markers, revealing their location to the SCP.
- [b]10-Minute Timer[/b]: A time limit of 10 minutes has been enforced; upon expiration, the match concludes, and a "desynced" state is initiated for remaining players.
- [b]Last One Standing[/b]: A silhouette now reveals the last surviving human, adding intensity to the endgame phase.
- [b]Usable Map for Humans[/b]: Humans are now equipped with a functional map, facilitating navigation, coordination, and identification of key items.
- [b]Pocket Dimension Ambience Music[/b]: The pocket dimension now features ambient music, enhancing the immersive experience.
- [b]HUD Task Display[/b]: The HUD now displays the number of remaining tasks, aiding the SCP in monitoring human progress.
- [b]SCP-173 Smoke Ability[/b]: A new ability for SCP-173 introduces a smoke effect, obstructing visibility for humans and creating strategic opportunities for the SCP.
- [b]Vignette Effect for SCP-106[/b]: A vignette effect is now displayed when SCP-106 traverses through walls, providing visual feedback.
- [b]Equipped Perks in Match Report[/b]: The match report now comprehensively showcases the equipped perks of each player, offering insights into their loadouts.
- [b]Fog [/b]is now integrated into all in-game maps, contributing to atmospheric diversity.
- [b]Map Descriptions[/b]: A valuable addition includes detailed descriptions for each map, enhancing player understanding and strategic decision-making.
- [b]Auto-Navigation to Tutorial[/b]: New players are automatically directed to the tutorial, ensuring a seamless introduction to the game.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
- [b]Quick Play Map Selection[/b]: Quick play now exclusively features completed maps, ensuring fairness and optimization in the gaming experience.
- [b]Pocket Dimension AI Navmesh[/b]: Resolved issues related to AI navmesh and navigation within the pocket dimension, enhancing overall gameplay fluidity.
- [b]Bot Spawn and Ready Delay[/b]: Increased delay for bot spawn and readiness, facilitating a smoother joining process for players.
- [b]Quick Join Loading Screen Map Background[/b]: Addressed an issue preventing the map background from displaying on the quick join loading screen.
- [b]SCP-106 Movement[/b]: SCP-106 no longer experiences falling when transitioning from the hall to the big entrance in the Police Station map.
- Rectified the inconsistency where Police Station doors opened twice, ensuring proper functionality.

notes.title: Quick Play Option
notes.content:
Patch notes for Update v0.3.7.5 - 20231226:

[b]New Feature - Quick Play Option:[/b]
- A new feature has been introduced in the main menu - Quick Play.
- Quick Play allows players to join a random lobby or host one if none are available.
- Designed to minimize queue times and maximize the number of matches played, the system will randomly select a map, playable character, and perk for each player.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Several bug fixes have been implemented to enhance overall game stability.

[b]Performance Improvements:[/b]
- The update includes enhancements to the game's performance, resulting in a smoother and more responsive gaming experience.

[b]General Notes:[/b]
- The addition of the Quick Play option aims to streamline the matchmaking process, ensuring players spend less time waiting and more time actively participating in matches.
- Players can now enjoy a diverse range of experiences with the random selection of maps, characters, and perks, adding an element of surprise and variety to each gaming session.

[b]Developer's Note:[/b]
We greatly appreciate the ongoing support from our player community. This update focuses on addressing bugs, optimizing performance, and introducing Quick Play to enhance the overall gameplay experience. We encourage players to explore the new feature and share their feedback to help us continue refining and improving the game. Thank you for being a part of our community!

notes.content:

notes.title: New 2 player gamemode, First Aid Kits and bugfixes!
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature: "Lone Wolf" 2 Player Gamemode![/h1]
Introducing a thrilling twist to the 1v4 objective gamemode! In Lone Wolf, the human player faces alone the SCP player, while completing a sequence of four non-branching tasks. The human's role, which reflect what task sequence has to complete, is randomly selected, ensuring each match offers a fresh experience.

[b]New Tactical Element: First Aid Kits![/b]
At the start of each match, eight First Aid Kits will spawn randomly across the map. Each kit provides  50 HP recovery. Exercise caution, as these kits are finite and won't reappear!

Additional Notes:
[list]
[*] Bug fixes and performance enhancements for a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for October 10, 2023 - v0.3 - 20231010
notes.content:
[h1][b]Research Department is now open![/b][/h1]

We're excited to introduce the Research Department in this latest update! This marks the beginning of a brand new [b]progression system[/b] tied to your account level. By playing either factions (SCP and/or humans), you'll level up and unlock an array of rewards.[i][b] Please keep in mind that the content is subject to change as this progression system is still in its very early stages.[/b][/i]

Currently, rewards for levels up to 100 include:
[list]
[*] Avatar Icons
[*] Avatar Borders
[*] Avatar Banners
[*] Avatar Backdrops
[*] Player titles
[*] SCP Perks
[*] Human Perks
[/list]
For now, you can equip one perk at a time. 
More content is bound to come as time goes on, including more customization options and gameplay add-ons.
